title: Race Condition
description: Find wall-phasing shortcuts on a racetrack that save 100+ picoseconds.
writeup:
## Approach

The racetrack has a unique path from S to E (no branches). A cheat lets you phase through walls for a limited number of steps.

## Key Insight

First, find the path and assign each cell its distance along the path. A cheat from path position `i` to position `j` saves `(j - i) - manhattan_distance(i, j)` steps. We just need to count all pairs where the Manhattan distance is within the cheat limit and the saving is ≥ 100.

## Part 1

Cheats last up to 2 steps. Check all pairs of path positions with Manhattan distance ≤ 2.

## Part 2

Cheats last up to 20 steps. Same approach, but with a larger distance threshold. The O(n²) pair check is feasible since the path length is manageable.
